entities.name: Bael

attributes.form: Cat, Toad, Man, or all at once
attributes.functions: Maketh thee to go Invisible

entities.raw_quote: The First Principal Spirit is a King ruling in the East, called Bael. He maketh thee to go Invisible.

entities.name: Agares

attributes.form: Old fair Man, riding upon a Crocodile, carrying a Goshawk
attributes.functions: Maketh them to run that stand still, bringeth back runaways, teaches all Languages, destroy Dignities, causeth Earthquakes

entities.raw_quote: The Second Spirit is a Duke called Agreas, or Agares. He is under the Power of the East, and cometh up in the form of an old fair Man.

entities.name: Vassago

attributes.functions: Declare things Past and to Come, discover all things Hid or Lost

entities.raw_quote: The Third Spirit is a Mighty Prince, being of the same nature as Agares. He is called Vassago.

entities.name: Samigina

attributes.form: Little Horse or Ass, then Human shape
attributes.functions: Teaches all Liberal Sciences, giveth account of Dead Souls that died in sin

entities.raw_quote: The Fourth Spirit is Samigina, a Great Marquis. He appeareth in the form of a little Horse or Ass.

entities.name: Marbas

attributes.form: Great Lion, then Human Shape
attributes.functions: Answereth truly of things Hidden or Secret, causeth Diseases and cureth them, Wisdom in Mechanical Arts, change men into other shapes

entities.raw_quote: The fifth Spirit is Marbas. He is a Great President, and appeareth at first in the form of a Great Lion.

entities.name: Valefor

attributes.form: Lion with an Ass's Head, bellowing
attributes.functions: Good Familiar, tempteth them he is a familiar of to steal

entities.raw_quote: The Sixth Spirit is Valefor. He is a mighty Duke, and appeareth in the shape of a Lion with an Ass's Head.

entities.name: Amon

attributes.form: Wolf with a Serpents tail, vomiting flames; or Man with Dog's teeth/Raven head
attributes.functions: Telleth all things Past and to Come, procureth feuds and reconcileth controversies

entities.raw_quote: The Seventh Spirit is Amon. He is a Marquis great in power, and most stern.

entities.name: Barbatos

attributes.form: With four noble Kings and their companies
attributes.functions: Understanding of singing of Birds, breaketh Hidden Treasures open, knoweth Past/Future, conciliateth Friends

entities.raw_quote: The Eighth Spirit is Barbatos. He is a Great Duke, and appeareth when the Sun is in Sagittary.

entities.name: Paimon

attributes.legions: 200 Legions of Spirits (part Angels, part Potentates)
attributes.form: Man sitting upon a Dromedary with a Crown most glorious
attributes.functions: Teach all Arts and Sciences, discover Earth/Mind, giveth Dignity, bindeth man subject unto Magician

entities.raw_quote: The Ninth Spirit in this Order is Paimon, a Great King, and very obedient unto LUCIFER.

entities.name: Buer

attributes.form: Appeareth in Sagittary
attributes.functions: Teaches Philosophy Moral and Natural, Logic Art, Virtues of Herbs, healeth distempers

entities.raw_quote: The Tenth Spirit is Buer, a Great President. He appeareth in Sagittary.

entities.name: Gusion

attributes.form: Like a Xenopilus
attributes.functions: Telleth Past/Present/Future, showeth meaning of questions, conciliateth friendships, giveth Honour

entities.raw_quote: The Eleventh Spirit in order is a great and strong Duke, called Gusion.

entities.name: Sitri

attributes.form: Leopard's head and Wings of a Gryphon, then Human shape beautiful
attributes.functions: Enflameth men with Women's love, causeth them to show themselves naked

entities.raw_quote: The Twelfth Spirit is Sitri. He is a Great Prince and appeareth at first with a Leopard's head.

entities.name: Beleth

attributes.form: Pale horse with trumpets and musical instruments playing before him
attributes.ritual_requirements: Hazel Wand, Triangle without Circle, Silver Ring on middle finger left hand

entities.raw_quote: The Thirteenth Spirit is called Beleth (or Bileth, or Bilet). He is a mighty King and terrible.

entities.name: Leraie

attributes.form: Archer clad in Green, carrying a Bow and Quiver
attributes.functions: Causeth all great Battles and Contests, maketh wounds to putrefy

entities.raw_quote: The Fourteenth Spirit is called Leraje (or Leraie). He is a Marquis Great in Power.

entities.name: Eligos

attributes.form: Goodly Knight, carrying a Lance, an Ensign, and a Serpent
attributes.functions: Discovereth hidden things, knoweth things to come, Wars, Love of Lords

entities.raw_quote: The Fifteenth Spirit in Order is Eligos, a Great Duke.

entities.name: Zepar

attributes.form: Red Apparel and Armour, like a Soldier
attributes.functions: Cause Women to love Men, bring them together in love, maketh them barren

entities.raw_quote: The Sixteenth Spirit is Zepar. He is a Great Duke, and appeareth in Red Apparel.

entities.name: Botis

attributes.form: Ugly Viper, then Human shape with Great Teeth and two Horns, carrying Sword
attributes.functions: Telleth Past/Future, reconcileth Friends and Foes

entities.raw_quote: The Seventeenth Spirit is Botis, a Great President, and an Earl.

entities.name: Bathin

attributes.form: Strong Man with the tail of a Serpent, sitting upon a Pale-Coloured Horse
attributes.functions: Knoweth Virtues of Herbs and Precious Stones, transport men suddenly

entities.raw_quote: The Eighteenth Spirit is Bathin. He is a Mighty and Strong Duke.

entities.name: Sallos

attributes.form: Gallant Soldier riding on a Crocodile, with a Ducal Crown
attributes.functions: Causeth the Love of Women to Men

entities.raw_quote: The Nineteenth Spirit is Sallos (or Saleos). He is a Great and Mighty Duke.

entities.name: Purson

attributes.form: Man with a Lion's face, carrying a cruel Viper, riding upon a Bear
attributes.functions: Knoweth hidden things, discover Treasure, Past/Present/Future, Creation of World

entities.raw_quote: The Twentieth Spirit is Purson, a Great King. His appearance is comely.

entities.name: Marax

attributes.form: Great Bull with a Man's face
attributes.functions: Make Men knowing in Astronomy, Liberal Sciences, give good Familiars

entities.raw_quote: The Twenty-first Spirit is Marax. He is a Great Earl and President.

entities.name: Ipos

attributes.form: Angel with a Lion's Head, and a Goose's Foot, and Hare's Tail
attributes.functions: Knoweth Past/Present/Future, maketh men witty and bold

entities.raw_quote: The Twenty-second Spirit is Ipos. He is an Earl, and a Mighty Prince.

entities.name: Aim

attributes.form: Handsome Man with three Heads (Serpent, Man w/ Stars, Calf), riding Viper
attributes.functions: Maketh thee witty, giveth true answers unto private matters

entities.raw_quote: The Twenty-third Spirit is Aim. He is a Great Strong Duke.
